strings.夜明けの直線で一気に伸びる差し馬。父アカツキオーの切れ味を最もよく受け継いだと言: A closer who surges down the dawn stretch. Said to have inherited the sharpest kick of its sire, Akatsuki Oh.
strings.先行して王道を行く一頭。どの展開でも崩れない落ち着きが持ち味。: A stalker who takes the classic route up front. Its calm holds up in any race shape.
strings.琥珀色の光をまとうように先頭を駆ける逃げ馬。スタートの速さは世代随一。: A front-runner that leads as if wrapped in amber light. The fastest starter of its generation.
strings.月影の夜に生まれた追い込み馬。最後方から豪快に差し切る。: A deep closer born on a moonlit night. Storms past the field from the very back.
strings.春風のように軽やかにハナを奪う。影を踏ませない逃げが得意。: Takes the lead as lightly as a spring breeze, and never lets the field catch its shadow.
strings.鉄のような脚を持つ追い込み馬。雷鳴のような末脚で知られる。: A deep closer with legs of iron, known for a finish like rolling thunder.
strings.芝もダートもこなす器用な先行馬。内ラチ沿いのコーナーワークが光る。: A versatile stalker on turf and dirt. Shines on the turns along the inside rail.
strings.海辺の牧場育ち。賑やかな性格で、直線の末脚は鋭い。: Raised on a seaside farm. Lively by nature, with a sharp finish in the stretch.
strings.稲妻のように飛び出す逃げ馬。苦しくなってからもうひと踏ん張りが利く。: A front-runner that bolts out like lightning, and still finds more when the going gets hard.
strings.並木道を行くように好位から抜け出す先行馬。: A stalker that slips clear from a good position, like strolling down a tree-lined lane.
strings.雪見の季節に生まれた先行馬。好位で粘る堅実な走り。: A stalker born in the snow-viewing season. Runs steadily and holds on from a good position.
strings.夏の嵐のように最後にひと伸びする先行馬。: A stalker that finds one last surge, like a summer storm.
strings.青空の下で一番槍を決める元気な逃げ馬。: A spirited front-runner that strikes first under a blue sky.
strings.夕焼けの中、風を読んで脚をためる差し馬。: A closer that reads the wind in the sunset and saves its strength.
strings.水面のリズムで大外を回る追い込み馬。: A deep closer that swings wide to the rhythm of the water.
strings.星降る丘の牧場出身。上手にひと息入れる差し馬。: From a farm on a hill of falling stars. A closer that knows when to catch its breath.
strings.風見鶏のように流れを読む先行馬。芝もダートも走る。: A stalker that reads the race like a weathervane. Runs on turf and dirt.
strings.森のしずくのように静かな逃げ馬。ペース配分がうまい。: A front-runner as quiet as a forest dewdrop, with a fine sense of pace.
strings.日の出とともに飛び出す快速の逃げ馬。: A speedy front-runner that bursts out with the sunrise.
strings.茜色の雲のように最後に伸びてくる追い込み馬。: A deep closer that comes late, like a crimson cloud at dusk.
strings.砂嵐を巻き上げて逃げるダートの名手。: A dirt specialist that leads from the front in a cloud of sand.
strings.重い馬場でも沈まない、ダートの先行馬。: A dirt stalker that never sinks, even on heavy going.
strings.河原の灯のように静かに機を待つダートの差し馬。: A dirt closer that waits quietly for its moment, like a lantern by the river.
strings.冬の夜に鐘を鳴らすように駆ける季節の一頭。: A seasonal horse that runs like bells ringing on a winter night.
strings.初雪のころに現れる季節の逃げ馬。どの馬場もこなす。: A seasonal front-runner that appears with the first snow. Handles any going.
strings.はじめての相棒。ここから物語が始まる。: Your first partner. This is where the story begins.
strings.牧場の母。はじめての配合を見守ってくれる。: The farm's mare. She watches over your first breeding.
strings.ゲートが開いた瞬間、誰よりも早く前へ。: The moment the gates open, forward before anyone else.
strings.先頭に立てば、後続に影すら踏ませない。: Once in front, the field never even reaches its shadow.
strings.疾風のように先頭を駆け抜ける。: Races through at the front like a gale.
strings.好位からの粘り腰。最後の直線で踏ん張る。: Grit from a good position. Holds on in the final stretch.
strings.直線で好位からすっと抜け出す。: Slips clear from a good position in the stretch.
strings.王道の位置取りから、直線で力強く伸びる。: From the classic position, pulls away strongly in the stretch.
strings.前の馬の後ろで風を読み、力をためる。: Reads the wind behind the horse ahead and saves its strength.
strings.後方から一閃の末脚。: A flashing finish from the back.
strings.鋭い切れ味で直線を切り裂く。: Cuts through the stretch with a razor-sharp kick.
strings.大外を回って一気に差し切る。: Swings wide and charges past in one run.
strings.雷のような速さで追い上げる。: Closes in with the speed of thunder.
strings.豪快な脚で最後方からまとめて差す。: Passes the whole field from the very back with a mighty stride.
strings.苦しいところでひと息入れて立て直す。: Catches a breath when it gets hard and recovers.
strings.残りわずかで、もうひと伸び。: One more surge, right at the end.
strings.内ラチ沿いのコーナーを誰よりもうまく回る。: Takes the turns along the inside rail better than anyone.
strings.苦しくなってから出る根性の二の脚。: A second wind of grit that comes when the going gets hard.
strings.青葉に囲まれたマイルの舞台。はじめてのレースもここから。: A mile course surrounded by green leaves. Your first race starts here.

strings.陽光の砂の1700m。乾いた砂が舞う。: 1700 m of sunlit sand, where dry dust flies.
